title: Employment and Community: Socioeconomic Cooperation and Its Breakdown
title_primary: Employment and Community: Socioeconomic Cooperation and Its Breakdown
authors: Daron Acemoglu, Alexander Wolitzky
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We model the interplay of employment relations and community-based interactions among workers and managers. Employment relations can be either tough (where workers are monitored intensively and obtain few rents, and managers do not provide informal favors for workers) or soft (where there is less monitoring, more worker rents, and more workplace favor exchange). Both workers and managers also exert effort in providing community public goods. The threat of losing access to public goods can motivate managers to keep employment soft; conversely, the threat of losing future employment or future workers’ trust can motivate workers and managers to provide effort in the community. Corporate tax cuts; improved worker monitoring; automation, outsourcing, and offshoring; declines in the minimum wage; and opportunities for residential segregation or for privatizing community-provided services can make both workers and managers worse-off by undermining soft employment relations and community cooperation.

title: Will New Transportation Technologies Increase Urban Density
title_zh: 新型交通技术是否会提升城市密度？
title_primary: 新型交通技术是否会提升城市密度？
title_secondary: Will New Transportation Technologies Increase Urban Density
authors: Edward L. Glaeser
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Will 21st century transportation innovations work against urban density, as the car did in the 20th century, or promote urban centralization, as the railroad did in the 19th century? Reducing the cost of commuting always reduces urban centralization in the classic Alonso-Muth-Mills model but that result reverses if the number of trips is endogenous and the elasticity of trips with respect to their costs is greater than one. That elasticity may have increased over time, as an increasing share of daily trips seems to be discretionary and city centers increasingly provide entertainment. This paper asks discusses the urbanizing effects of four trends in transportation technology: shared mobility (such as Uber), autonomy (such as Waymo), vertical travel and green mobility, as provided by bike lane. As people spend more time travelling in denser, large areas, innovations that reduce the time cost of travel, such as autonomous cars, seem likely to complement urban living, as long as they don’t excessively increase traffic. Sharing is also easier in big cities, so technologies that involve sharing are also centripetal. The other trends seem less likely to have major effects. Moreover, the forces of inertia, which include both regulation and legacy infrastructure, are likely to limit the impact of any new technologies in Europe and the U.S., so that the biggest changes in urban form are likely to appear in east Asia and the developing world.

title: Central Bank Independence at Low Interest Rates
title_zh: 低利率环境下的中央银行独立性
title_primary: 低利率环境下的中央银行独立性
title_secondary: Central Bank Independence at Low Interest Rates
authors: BENJAMÍN GARCÍA, ARSENIOS SKAPERDAS
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We create a new measure of the political pressure faced by the Federal Reserve based on the analysis of transcripts of the Chairs' testimonies to Congress. We find that the use of nontraditional policies at low interest rates led to increased political criticism and that criticism predicts legislative actions that threaten central bank independence. We develop a model where the probability of the monetary authority's future loss of independence is increasing in the use of nontraditional instruments, leading to attenuated monetary responses and higher inflation volatility. This attenuation can be mitigated under an institutional framework with clearly defined targets where the central bank is evaluated by how efficiently it achieves its goals.
abstract_zh: 我们基于对美联储主席国会证词记录的分析，构建了一个衡量美联储所面临政治压力的新指标。研究发现，在低利率环境下采用非传统政策引发了更多的政治批评，而这些批评预示着可能威胁中央银行独立性的立法行动。我们建立了一个模型，其中货币当局未来丧失独立性的概率随着非传统工具的使用而增加，这导致货币政策反应减弱并加剧通胀波动。在目标明确界定的制度框架下，若中央银行依据其实现目标的效率被评估，这种减弱效应可以得到缓解。

title: Do Business-Friendly Reforms Boost GDP?
title_zh: 亲商改革能否促进GDP增长？
title_primary: 亲商改革能否促进GDP增长？
title_secondary: Do Business-Friendly Reforms Boost GDP?
authors: Tamanna Adhikari, Karl Whelan
official: 官方在线 2021-03-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use the time series variation in the World Bank's ``distance to frontier'' estimates of the ease of doing business to assess the effects of changes in this variable on real GDP per capita. The use of Vector Autoregression techniques allows us to identify shocks to the ease of doing business that are initially uncorrelated with GDP, thus addressing an important endogeneity problem that affects the cross-sectional literature on this topic. The results are surprising. We report a robust finding that improvements to the ease of doing business have at least a temporary negative impact on GDP and find little evidence for a positive effect in the years following these improvements.
abstract_zh: 我们利用世界银行“距离前沿”指标中关于营商环境便利度的时间序列变化，来评估该变量变动对实际人均GDP的影响。通过采用向量自回归技术，我们能够识别出与GDP初始不相关的营商环境便利度冲击，从而解决了该领域横截面研究中存在的重要内生性问题。结果令人意外。我们报告了一个稳健的发现：营商环境便利度的改善至少对GDP产生暂时性的负面影响，并且在改善后的几年内，几乎没有证据表明存在正面效应。

title: Equilibrium Yield Curves and the Interest Rate Lower Bound
title_zh: 均衡收益率曲线与利率下限
title_primary: 均衡收益率曲线与利率下限
title_secondary: Equilibrium Yield Curves and the Interest Rate Lower Bound
authors: Taisuke Nakata, Hiroatsu Tanaka
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the term structure of default-free interest rates in a sticky-price model with an occasionally binding effective lower bound (ELB) constraint on interest rates and recursive preferences. The ELB constraint induces state-dependency in the dynamics of term premiums by affecting macroeconomic uncertainty and interest-rate sensitivity to economic activities. In a model calibrated to match key features of the aggregate economy and term structure dynamics in the U.S. above and at the ELB, we find that the ELB constraint typically lowers the absolute size of term premiums at the ELB and increases their volatility around the time of liftoff. The central bank's announcement to keep the policy rate at the ELB for longer than previously expected lowers the expected short rate path, but its effect on term premiums depends on the risk exposure of bonds to the macroeconomy; while the announcement increases term premiums if bonds are a hedge against economic downturns, it decreases them otherwise.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个校准的DSGE模型，其中短期名义利率面临偶尔约束的有效下界（ELB），该模型匹配了美国宏观经济和利率期限结构的关键特征。我们表明，ELB约束通过影响宏观经济不确定性和利率对经济活动的敏感度，引发期限溢价的态依赖性，通常降低期限溢价的绝对规模，并在接近ELB时产生独特的动态变化。在ELB处，中央银行的前瞻指引降低了预期短期利率路径，但根据需求冲击或供给冲击的主导地位，期限溢价可能增加或减少。

title: Born in smog: immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
title_zh: 生于雾霾：历史伦敦急性空气污染暴露的即时与持久健康后果，1892-1919
title_primary: 生于雾霾：历史伦敦急性空气污染暴露的即时与持久健康后果，1892-1919
title_secondary: Born in smog: immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
authors: Schneider, Eric B.
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理指标，这些雾事件反映了城市排放的污染物未能扩散至空间的气象条件，导致污染急剧飙升。同时，我采用了来自皇后夏洛特医院（一家妇产医院）和育婴堂医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结果、生长结果或上呼吸道发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的暴露对健康产生了持续性影响，增加了儿童期及青春期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感和麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内及产后污染暴露未显示出持续性效应。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染对儿童健康的特定维度产生了持久影响，但影响范围有限。

title: Tariffs, Investment, and the Missing Trade Collapse
title_zh: 关税、投资与贸易崩溃之谜
title_primary: 关税、投资与贸易崩溃之谜
title_secondary: Tariffs, Investment, and the Missing Trade Collapse
authors: Francesco Ferrante, Andrea Prestipino, Andrea Raffo, Michael E. Waugh
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: U.S. tariff rates in 2025 rose to levels not seen since the Great Depression, yet imports increased. To account for the missing trade collapse, we develop an open-economy New Keynesian model with tariff heterogeneity, inventories, and shocks to investment that capture the AI-driven boom. The model matches the untargeted paths of imports, output, and inflation; we use it to decompose the effects of tariffs and the investment boom. Absent the investment boom, imports would have fallen by 10 percent and activity would have contracted by 0.7 percent. The effects of tariffs depend on which goods are tariffed: tariffs on consumption and intermediates act like shocks to supply; tariffs on capital goods act like shocks to demand. The concentration of the 2025 tariff increases on consumption goods and the relative sparing of capital goods limited the damage to output while amplifying the inflationary impulse.
abstract_zh: 2025年美国的关税税率升至大萧条以来未见的高位，然而进口却有所增加。为解释这一缺失的贸易崩溃现象，我们构建了一个包含关税异质性、库存以及捕捉人工智能驱动繁荣的投资冲击的开放经济新凯恩斯主义模型。该模型与进口、产出和通胀的非目标路径相吻合；我们利用它来分解关税与投资繁荣的影响。若无投资繁荣，进口本将下降10%，经济活动本将收缩0.7%。关税的影响取决于被征税的商品种类：对消费品和中间品征收关税类似于供给冲击；对资本品征收关税则类似于需求冲击。2025年关税上调集中于消费品，而对资本品相对宽松，这一结构限制了对产出的损害，同时放大了通胀压力。

title: Credit Constraints and Capital Allocation in Agriculture: Theory and Evidence from Uganda
title_zh: 农业中的信贷约束与资本配置：理论与来自乌干达的证据
title_primary: 农业中的信贷约束与资本配置：理论与来自乌干达的证据
title_secondary: Credit Constraints and Capital Allocation in Agriculture: Theory and Evidence from Uganda
authors: Konrad Burchardi, Benedetta Lerva, Jonathan de Quidt, Stefano Tripodi, Bruno Caprettini 等
official: 官方在线 2026-01-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper presents results from a theory-guided experiment on fertilizer adoption among Ugandan farmers, finding that there exists a group of farmers with high returns to fertilizer, who would not adopt at the market price but can be induced to adopt with a 30% subsidy. Furthermore, consistent with adoption frictions due to liquidity constraints, the results indicate that a cash transfer is sufficient to eliminate the need for subsidies. These findings tie into broader ideas on second-best policymaking (Lipsey and Lancaster, 1956) and have important implications for fertilizer policy in Africa.
abstract_zh: 本文通过一项理论指导的实验，探讨了乌干达农民采用化肥的情况。研究发现，存在一群对化肥有高回报率的农民，他们在市场价格下不会采用化肥，但通过30%的补贴可以促使其采用。此外，与流动性约束导致的采用摩擦相一致，结果表明，现金转移足以消除补贴的需求。这些发现与次优政策制定的更广泛理念（Lipsey和Lancaster，1956）相呼应，并对非洲的化肥政策具有重要意义。

title: Multiscale Comparison of Nonparametric Trend Curves
title_zh: 非参数趋势曲线的多尺度比较
title_primary: 非参数趋势曲线的多尺度比较
title_secondary: Multiscale Comparison of Nonparametric Trend Curves
authors: Marina Khismatullina, Michael Vogt
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop new econometric methods for the comparison of nonparametric time trends. In many applications, practitioners are interested in examining the trending behaviour of multiple time series. Among other things, they would like to know which time series have different trends and in which time intervals the differences occur. We design a multiscale test to formally approach these questions. Specifically, we develop a test which allows to make rigorous confidence statements about which time trends are different and where (i.e., in which time intervals) they differ. Based on our multiscale test, we further develop a clustering algorithm which allows to cluster the observed time series into groups with the same trending behaviour. We derive asymptotic theory for our test and clustering methods. The theory is complemented by a simulation study and two applications to house pricing and GDP growth data.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了新的计量经济学方法，用于比较非参数时间趋势。在许多应用中，实践者关注于检验多个时间序列的趋势行为。除其他事项外，他们希望了解哪些时间序列具有不同的趋势，以及差异发生在哪些时间区间。我们设计了一个多尺度检验来正式处理这些问题。具体而言，我们开发了一种检验方法，能够对哪些时间趋势不同以及它们在何处（即哪些时间区间）存在差异做出严格的置信陈述。基于我们的多尺度检验，我们进一步开发了一种聚类算法，该算法能够将观测到的时间序列聚类为具有相同趋势行为的组。我们为我们的检验和聚类方法推导了渐近理论。该理论辅以模拟研究以及两个应用案例，分别涉及房价和GDP增长数据。

title: Effects of climate activism on firm productivity and uncertainty: Evidence from global oil extraction
title_zh: 气候行动主义对企业生产率和不确定性的影响：来自全球石油开采的证据
title_primary: 气候行动主义对企业生产率和不确定性的影响：来自全球石油开采的证据
title_secondary: Effects of climate activism on firm productivity and uncertainty: Evidence from global oil extraction
authors: Morakinyo O. Adetutu, Anthony Glass, Abbi Kedir, Karligash Glass
official: 官方在线 2026-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present global microeconometric evidence on the impact of climate advocacy on hydrocarbon production. We construct two panel data sets by first linking climate activist campaigns to several thousand oil fields, which together account for 72% of global production. Second, we use textual analysis of over 140 million words from 1832 annual reports to compute a measure of activism-induced uncertainty for the corporations that control these oil fields. We find robust evidence that climate activism directly reduced not only oil field productivity but also increased company-level uncertainty. By utilising the ownership links between corporations and their oil fields, we also uncover an indirect mechanism in which the initial activism-induced company uncertainty leads to further productivity losses at the field level. Our findings demonstrate the presence of two pathways through which climate advocacy impacts hydrocarbon extraction.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于气候倡导对碳氢化合物生产影响的全球微观计量经济学证据。我们首先将气候活动家的运动与数千个油田联系起来，这些油田合计占全球产量的72%，据此构建了两个面板数据集。其次，我们通过对1832份年度报告中超过1.4亿词进行文本分析，计算了控制这些油田的企业所面临的活动引发的确定性指标。我们发现强有力的证据表明，气候倡导不仅直接降低了油田生产率，还增加了企业层面的不确定性。通过利用企业与其油田之间的所有权联系，我们还揭示了一种间接机制，即最初由活动引发的企业不确定性导致油田层面的进一步生产率损失。我们的研究结果表明，气候倡导通过两条途径影响碳氢化合物的开采。

title: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
title_zh: 公共与私人医疗体系之间的选择：来自退伍军人的证据
title_primary: 公共与私人医疗体系之间的选择：来自退伍军人的证据
title_secondary: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
authors: Cabral, Marika, Chan, David C., Neller, Seth
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the choice between public and private healthcare systems among elderly veterans, who are dually eligible to obtain care through the publicly operated Veterans Health Administration (VA) and through private providers financed by Medicare. We analyze health system choice among veterans who move across areas with differing rates of VA utilization to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (e.g., preferences, income, health) and place-specific factors (e.g., local access, quality, and convenience). Our estimates indicate that 50–60% of geographic variation in VA use is attributable to demand-side individual factors, with the remainder explained by place-based factors. We also document important heterogeneity across types of care, with place-based factors playing a larger role for inpatient and emergency care than for outpatient and primary care. Additional analysis suggests that the supply-side features emphasized in recent legislation—distance to VA facilities and wait times—explain only a small share of estimated place effects. These findings highlight the importance of individual factors in health system choice and have implications for policies aimed at reducing geographic disparities in VA utilization.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了老年退伍军人在公共与私营医疗体系之间的选择问题，这些退伍军人有资格同时通过公立的退伍军人健康管理局（VA）和由联邦医疗保险（Medicare）资助的私营提供者获得医疗服务。我们分析了那些迁移至VA利用率不同地区的退伍军人的医疗体系选择，以量化个体特定因素（如偏好、收入、健康状况）与地区特定因素（如当地可及性、质量和便利性）的相对重要性。我们的估计表明，VA使用中50%至60%的地理差异可归因于需求侧的个体因素，其余部分则由地区因素解释。我们还记录了不同护理类型间的重要异质性，其中地区因素对住院和急诊护理的影响大于对门诊和初级护理的影响。进一步分析表明，近期立法中强调的供给侧特征——与VA设施的距离和等待时间——仅解释了估计的地区效应的一小部分。这些发现凸显了个体因素在医疗体系选择中的重要性，并对旨在减少VA利用地理差异的政策具有启示意义。

title: From Banks to Nonbanks: Macroprudential and Monetary Policy Effects on Corporate Lending
title_zh: 从银行到非银行：宏观审慎与货币政策对企业贷款的影响
title_primary: 从银行到非银行：宏观审慎与货币政策对企业贷款的影响
title_secondary: From Banks to Nonbanks: Macroprudential and Monetary Policy Effects on Corporate Lending
authors: Albuquerque, Bruno, Cerutti, Eugenio, Chen, Nanyu, Firat, Melih
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: The growing role of nonbanks in corporate credit intermediation raises important yet underexplored questions about the transmission of monetary policy (MP) and macroprudential policy (MaPP) to the real economy. Using syndicated loan data, we find that nonbanks act as shock absorbers, cushioning nonfinancial firms from both MaPP and MP tightening. These shocks drive credit away from weaker banks toward nonbanks, raising concerns about credit quality. Our findings highlight that the side effects of tighter MaPP and MP are nontrivial as credit intermediation migrates to a sector largely outside the regulatory perimeter, posing new financial stability risks.
abstract_zh: 非银行机构在企业信贷中介中日益增长的作用，引发了关于货币政策与宏观审慎政策向实体经济传导的重要但尚未充分探讨的问题。利用银团贷款数据，我们发现非银行机构充当了冲击吸收器，缓冲了非金融企业面临的宏观审慎政策和货币政策收紧冲击。这些冲击促使信贷从实力较弱的银行流向非银行机构，引发了对信贷质量的担忧。我们的研究结果强调，随着信贷中介活动向基本处于监管范围之外的部门转移，宏观审慎政策和货币政策的收紧会产生不容忽视的副作用，从而带来新的金融稳定风险。

title: Oligopoly and Trade
title_zh: 寡头垄断与贸易
title_primary: 寡头垄断与贸易
title_secondary: Oligopoly and Trade
authors: Peter Neary, Dermot Leahy
official: 官方在线 2010-12-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this chapter we present a selective analytic survey of some of the main results of trade under oligopoly. We concentrate on three topics: oligopoly as an independent determinant of trade, as illustrated by the reciprocal-markets model of Brander (1981); oligopoly as an independent rationale for government intervention, as illustrated by strategic trade and industrial policy in the third-market model of Spencer and Brander (1983); and the challenges and potential of embedding trade under oligopoly in general equilibrium as illustrated by the GOLE model of Neary (2002).
abstract_zh: 本章对寡头垄断下贸易的一些主要结果进行了选择性分析综述。我们聚焦于三个主题：寡头垄断作为贸易的独立决定因素，以Brander（1981）的互惠市场模型为例；寡头垄断作为政府干预的独立理据，以Spencer与Brander（1983）的第三市场模型中的战略性贸易与产业政策为例；以及将寡头垄断下的贸易嵌入一般均衡的挑战与潜力，以Neary（2002）的GOLE模型为例。

title: Quality, Selection, and Congestion: Equilibrium Hospital Outcomes During Covid-19
title_zh: 质量、选择与拥挤：新冠疫情期间医院均衡结果
title_primary: 质量、选择与拥挤：新冠疫情期间医院均衡结果
title_secondary: Quality, Selection, and Congestion: Equilibrium Hospital Outcomes During Covid-19
authors: Gautam Gowrisankaran, Kelli R. Marquardt, Robert Town
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine the importance of hospital quality, patient selection, and congestion in affecting equilibrium health outcomes, using Covid-19 pandemic data. Our main outcome is mortality, controlling for unobserved selection with distance instruments. Intensive care unit strain increased hospital mortality: without congestion, deaths would fall 9.6%. Patients value hospitals with high baseline quality, but their choices did not reflect capacity strain information. Equilibrium counterfactuals show that if patients were informed about capacity strain and believed quality signals were more precise, deaths would drop 3.8%. However, using more precise information but not accounting for congestion would cause Covid-19 deaths to rise 3.8%.
abstract_zh: 我们利用新冠疫情数据，考察了医院质量、患者选择及拥挤程度对均衡健康结果的影响。主要结局指标为死亡率，并通过距离工具变量控制未观测到的选择偏差。重症监护病房的负荷增加了医院死亡率：若无拥挤，死亡人数将下降9.6%。患者倾向于选择基线质量较高的医院，但其选择并未反映容量压力信息。均衡反事实分析显示，若患者获知容量压力信息并认为质量信号更为精确，死亡人数将减少3.8%。然而，若仅使用更精确的信息而未考虑拥挤因素，则会导致新冠死亡人数上升3.8%。

title: From Tap Water Access to Income‐Generating Work Time: Evidence From Rural China
title_zh: 从自来水接入到创收工作时间：来自中国农村的证据
title_primary: 从自来水接入到创收工作时间：来自中国农村的证据
title_secondary: From Tap Water Access to Income‐Generating Work Time: Evidence From Rural China
authors: Yiyi Zhao
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines whether household tap water access affects income‐generating work time among employed rural adults in China. While existing studies have mainly examined the effects of improved water access on employment participation, off‐farm transition and household income, this paper focuses on the intensive margin of labour supply within existing livelihood activities. Drawing on household production and time allocation theory, household tap water access is conceptualised as reducing the time cost of routine domestic production, thereby releasing time that may be reallocated to income‐generating work and other household activities. Using rural panel data from the China Family Panel Studies from 2014 to 2022, the analysis applies individual fixed‐effects models and instrumental variables fixed‐effects (IV‐FE) estimates. The fixed effects results show that household tap water access is associated with approximately one additional hour of income‐generating work per week among employed rural adults. Under the IV identifying assumptions, the IV‐FE estimates suggest a larger positive effect. Additional time‐use analysis indicates that household tap water access reduces daily housework time by about 0.29 h and modestly increases midday nap duration, while no statistically significant changes are found for television watching or leisure reading. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that the increase in work time is concentrated among agricultural workers, self‐employed individuals, prime‐age adults and individuals living in households without young children.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了家庭自来水供应是否影响中国农村就业成年人的创收工作时间。现有研究主要关注改善水资源获取对就业参与、非农转移和家庭收入的影响，而本文聚焦于现有生计活动中劳动力供给的集约边际。基于家庭生产与时间分配理论，家庭自来水供应被概念化为降低日常家务生产的时间成本，从而释放出可能重新分配至创收工作及其他家庭活动的时间。利用2014年至2022年中国家庭追踪调查的农村面板数据，本文采用个体固定效应模型和工具变量固定效应估计。固定效应结果显示，家庭自来水供应与农村就业成年人每周约增加一小时的创收工作时间相关。在工具变量识别假设下，工具变量固定效应估计表明存在更大的正向效应。额外的时间使用分析显示，家庭自来水供应使每日家务时间减少约0.29小时，并适度增加午睡时长，而看电视或休闲阅读的时间未发现统计显著变化。异质性分析表明，工作时间的增加主要集中在农业劳动者、自雇者、壮年成年人以及无幼儿家庭中的个体。

title: How Effective Are R&D Tax Incentives? Reconciling the Micro and Macro Evidence

title_primary: 研发税收激励的有效性如何？调和微观与宏观证据

authors: Appelt, Silvia, Bajgar, Matěj, Criscuolo, Chiara, Galindo-Rueda, Fernando
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Recent firm-level studies find R&D tax incentives to be much more effective at stimulating firms’ R&D investment than aggregate analyses suggest. Based on a distributed analysis of official R&D survey and administrative tax relief microdata for 19 OECD countries, we show that two factors can reconcile these contrasting results. Firstly, the limited uptake of R&D tax incentives in most countries makes aggregate studies underestimate the effectiveness of R&D tax incentives. Secondly, R&D tax incentives are (much) less effective for large and R&D-intensive firms, which account for a small share of R&D-performing firms but most aggregate R&D tax relief.
abstract_zh: 近期基于企业层面的研究发现，研发税收激励对刺激企业研发投资的效力远高于宏观分析所显示的水平。通过对19个OECD国家官方研发调查数据与行政税收减免微观数据的分布式分析，我们揭示两个因素可调和上述矛盾结论：其一，多数国家研发税收激励的有限采用率导致宏观研究低估其有效性；其二，研发税收激励对大型及高研发密集型企业（虽仅占研发企业的小部分，却集中了大部分宏观研发税收减免）的效力显著偏低。

abstract: Focus In January 2023, Colombia introduced new banking rules. These rules required banks to set aside more money to cover risks from long-term consumer loans. The goal was to reduce risks tied to lending with long repayment periods, especially during a time of strong credit growth. This paper looks at how these changes affected banks and their lending practices.

title: Adversarial bargaining with exogenous shocks

authors: Pablo Cuellar, Lucas Rentschler
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines equilibrium strategies in adversarial bargaining, which are negotiations where one party demands concessions under threat of initiating a destructive conflict. We develop a multi-period model incorporating both endogenous conflict decisions and the risk of exogenous conflict, analyzing how outcomes depend on threat credibility and patience levels. Three types of equilibrium emerge: impatient aggressors extract the maximum concession through credible deterministic threats; highly patient scenarios feature probabilistic threats where exogenous risk creates bargaining power; and intermediate patience levels produce mixed-strategy threats. We distinguish between scenarios where conflict benefits the aggressor versus where conflict harms both parties, leading to brinkmanship. Our results reveal a striking non-monotonic relationship between patience and equilibrium demands when conflict benefits the aggressor.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了对抗性谈判中的均衡策略，此类谈判是指一方在威胁发动破坏性冲突的条件下要求对方让步的协商过程。我们构建了一个多期模型，同时纳入内生冲突决策与外生冲突风险，分析结果如何取决于威胁的可信度及耐心程度。均衡呈现三种类型：缺乏耐心的侵略者通过可信的确定性威胁获取最大让步；高度耐心的情境则涉及概率性威胁，其中外生风险赋予谈判筹码；而中等耐心水平则产生混合策略威胁。我们区分了冲突对侵略者有利与冲突对双方均有害的两种情形，后者导致边缘政策。研究结果显示，当冲突对侵略者有利时，耐心程度与均衡要求之间存在显著的非单调关系。

title: Framing plant-rich eating: an analysis of nutritional public policies in Portugal
title_zh: 构建植物性饮食框架：葡萄牙营养公共政策分析
title_primary: 构建植物性饮食框架：葡萄牙营养公共政策分析
title_secondary: Framing plant-rich eating: an analysis of nutritional public policies in Portugal
authors: Cristina Romanelli
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The ways in which governments legitimize and promote plant-rich eating remain underexplored, particularly in contexts where animal-based foods retain strong cultural and political significance. Focusing primarily on nutritional governance, this study examines the institutional mechanisms through which plant foods and plant-rich practices have been framed as objects of public intervention in Portugal since the inception of the National Program for the Promotion of Healthy Eating in 2012. Adopting a qualitative, discourse-oriented, and semiotically informed approach, the study conceptualizes public intervention as a dispositif that actively shapes meanings and norms around food. Findings show that the legitimization of plant-rich eating relies on strategically cautious discourse emphasizing health, sustainability, and heritage, while avoiding explicit advocacy of vegetarianism. The Mediterranean diet emerges as the primary legitimizing model, enabling plant foods without challenging the centrality of meat and fish. Risk prevention and responsibilization further structure these discourses, framing citizens as self-monitoring consumers. Ultimately, plant-rich eating is cautiously legitimized yet continually negotiated, absorbed into broader narratives of health, sustainability, and national identity. As the first European country to legally require the availability of vegetarian meals in public canteens, Portugal offers insights for other national contexts, particularly regarding discursive strategies, risk-based governance, the symbolic status of animal and plant products, and the role of institutional environments in normalizing plant-rich eating. These findings also resonate with developments elsewhere while highlighting context-specific dynamics.
abstract_zh: 政府如何合法化并推广植物性饮食仍是一个研究不足的领域，尤其是在动物性食品仍具有深厚文化及政治意义的背景下。本研究聚焦营养治理，考察自2012年葡萄牙启动《促进健康饮食国家计划》以来，植物性食品及植物性饮食实践被构建为公共干预对象的制度机制。采用定性、话语导向及符号学分析路径，本研究将公共干预概念化为一个积极塑造食品意义与规范的"装置"。研究发现，植物性饮食的合法化依赖于策略性谨慎话语，强调健康、可持续性与传统遗产，同时避免明确倡导素食主义。地中海饮食模式成为主要的合法化模型，既推广植物性食品又不挑战肉类与鱼类的主导地位。风险预防与责任化进一步构建了这些话语，将公民塑造为自我监控的消费者。最终，植物性饮食虽被谨慎合法化，却持续处于协商状态，被吸纳进健康、可持续性与国家认同的宏大叙事中。作为首个通过法律要求公共食堂提供素食的欧洲国家，葡萄牙为其他国家的实践提供了启示，尤其在话语策略、风险治理、动植物产品的象征地位以及制度环境对植物性饮食常态化的作用方面。这些发现亦与其他地区的发展相呼应，同时凸显了特定情境的动态特征。

abstract: We develop a macro model with financial frictions where high-productivity farmers must rent land and face ambiguity about production. Ambiguity makes land demand state dependent: it is pro-cyclical when farmers fear low expected returns and counter-cyclical when they anticipate higher future rental costs. Pro-cyclical demand compresses production in downturns and yields competing effects on the net-worth trap. With moderate ambiguity aversion, farmers cut land use, lowering endogenous risk and avoiding the trap. With strong aversion, it slows net-worth rebuilding, leading to sluggish recoveries and economic vulnerability.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦的宏观模型，其中高生产率农户必须租用土地并面临生产中的模糊性。模糊性使土地需求具有状态依赖性：当农户担忧预期回报较低时，土地需求呈顺周期性；而当他们预期未来租金成本上升时，则呈逆周期性。顺周期需求在经济下行期压缩生产，并对净值陷阱产生竞争性效应。在适度模糊厌恶下，农户减少土地使用，降低内生风险，从而避免陷阱。而在强烈厌恶下，这会减缓净值重建，导致复苏乏力与经济脆弱性。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What information do policymakers need to design Pigouvian taxes or subsidies? Standard logic suggests that it is sufficient to know the size of the externality and unnecessary to know about quantities. Yet this logic is incorrect if interventions have fixed costs, taxes create deadweight losses, or there are distributional concerns. We present a model in which these considerations can make it more valuable for policymakers to learn about equilibrium quantities. We apply the model to congestion pricing, which has high fixed costs, and to a proposed housing subsidy in Boston that features deadweight losses and distributional concerns.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者设计庇古税或补贴时需要哪些信息？标准逻辑认为，只需了解外部性的大小，无需掌握数量信息。然而，若干预措施存在固定成本、税收产生无谓损失或涉及分配问题，这一逻辑便不再成立。我们构建了一个模型，表明在这些考量下，政策制定者了解均衡数量可能更具价值。我们将该模型应用于具有高固定成本的拥堵定价，以及波士顿一项涉及无谓损失和分配问题的拟议住房补贴。

title: Paying for Quality vs. Paying for Rank: When Purifying a Metric Backfires

authors: Joshua S. Gans, Scott Duke Kominers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Matching markets allocate scarce opportunities using performance metrics that agents can game. When does making a metric less gameable actually reduce gaming? We show that the answer hinges on how the market converts evaluations into stakes. Where evaluations assign prices — wages, credit terms, score-indexed payments — partially purifying the metric raises gaming precisely when gameable variation dominates it: the market's trust in the metric then rises faster than its exposure to gaming falls. By contrast, where evaluations assign positions — fixed seats allocated by rank — purification never backfires: ranking cancels trust from the incentive, leaving a rank price that deflates with the metric's dispersion, so mean gaming falls monotonically. We solve both markets in closed form under a first-order equilibrium concept; transfers microfound the first regime, rank tournaments the second. A prize-curvature index then determines when gaming improves rather than harms sorting, and when perfecting the metric is itself sorting-suboptimal.
abstract_zh: 匹配市场利用代理人可操纵的绩效指标来分配稀缺机会。何时降低指标的可操纵性反而会减少操纵行为？研究表明，答案取决于市场如何将评估转化为利害关系。当评估与价格挂钩——如工资、信贷条件、按分数支付的款项——时，若可操纵性变异占主导地位，部分净化指标反而会提高操纵行为：此时市场对指标的信任度上升速度快于其暴露于操纵风险的下降速度。相比之下，当评估与职位挂钩——如按排名分配固定席位——时，净化指标绝不会适得其反：排名机制消除了激励中的信任因素，留下一个随指标离散程度而缩水的排名价格，因此平均操纵行为单调递减。我们在一阶均衡概念下以闭式解求解了两种市场模型；转移支付为第一种机制提供了微观基础，排名锦标赛则为第二种机制提供了基础。随后，一个奖励曲率指数决定了何时操纵行为能改善而非损害筛选效果，以及何时完善指标本身反而会降低筛选效率。

abstract: This study investigates and compares US consumer perceptions and the impact of environmental, human health, and animal welfare information related to conventional meat on preferences for meat alternatives and labeling policies. Using the best–worst scaling method across 10 different burger alternatives, our results show that the meat burger is largely the most preferred option, while meat alternatives collectively account for nearly 40% of total consumer preferences. Information about the health effects of meat consumption and consumer characteristics influences preferences for meat alternatives. Consumers perceive the meat burger as tastier, more natural, more nutritious, and more expensive. In contrast, the plant burger is viewed as healthier and more environmentally friendly, while also being perceived as very distinct from the meat burger. Interestingly, most consumers oppose labeling meat alternatives as “meat.” Our findings provide useful insights into the psychology of consumer acceptance, which can be useful in communicating the nature of meat alternatives to the public and shaping meat alternatives labeling policies.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨并比较了美国消费者对传统肉类相关环境、人类健康及动物福利信息的认知，以及这些信息对肉类替代品偏好和标签政策的影响。采用最优-最差标度方法对10种不同的汉堡替代品进行分析，结果显示，肉类汉堡在很大程度上是最受青睐的选择，而肉类替代品合计约占消费者总偏好的近40%。关于肉类消费健康影响的信息以及消费者特征会影响对肉类替代品的偏好。消费者认为肉类汉堡更美味、更天然、更有营养，且价格更高。相比之下，植物汉堡被视为更健康、更环保，同时被认为与肉类汉堡差异显著。有趣的是，大多数消费者反对将肉类替代品标注为“肉类”。我们的研究结果为消费者接受心理提供了有益见解，这些见解可用于向公众传达肉类替代品的本质，并有助于制定肉类替代品的标签政策。

title: Financial Intermediation and Aggregate Demand: A Sufficient Statistics Approach
title_zh: 金融中介与总需求：一个充分统计量方法
title_primary: 金融中介与总需求：一个充分统计量方法
title_secondary: Financial Intermediation and Aggregate Demand: A Sufficient Statistics Approach
authors: Yu-Ting Chiang, Piotr Zoch
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that the financial sector’s asset supply elasticities are sufficient statistics summarizing its macroeconomic effects for a large class of financial frictions. These elasticities are crucial for a wide range of policy questions, ranging from the size of fiscal multipliers to the relative effectiveness of asset purchases targeting the financial sector versus tax cuts targeting households. Workhorse macroeconomic models imply different values of these elasticities, generating output responses to policies that differ by orders of magnitude. We construct empirical measures of these elasticities and evaluate their policy implications in a quantitative model with household heterogeneity and illiquidity.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，对于一大类金融摩擦而言，金融部门的资产供给弹性是概括其宏观经济效应的充分统计量。这些弹性对于广泛的政策问题至关重要，涵盖从财政乘数的大小到针对金融部门的资产购买与针对家庭的减税政策相对有效性的比较。主流宏观经济模型对这些弹性赋予了不同的数值，导致政策对产出的影响幅度相差数个数量级。我们构建了这些弹性的实证度量指标，并在包含家庭异质性与非流动性的量化模型中评估其政策含义。

title: Light after the darkness: Estimating the impact of power outages on subsequent solar installations
title_zh: 黑暗之后的光明：评估停电对后续太阳能安装的影响
title_primary: 黑暗之后的光明：评估停电对后续太阳能安装的影响
title_secondary: Light after the darkness: Estimating the impact of power outages on subsequent solar installations
authors: Chihiro Yagi, Kenji Takeuchi
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Unexpected shocks to the electricity supply can influence people’s decision to invest in renewable energy, particularly when these technologies serve as substitutes for backup power. This study investigates the impact of a large-scale power outage on subsequent photovoltaic (PV) installations and examines how households and firms evaluate the expected benefits of PV systems as an emergency power source. Using a doubly-robust difference-in-differences design, we exploit the 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi Earthquake in Japan as a natural experiment to estimate the effect of the subsequent blackout on municipality-level PV installations. Our results show that the blackout significantly increased commercial PV installations but had no effect on residential installations. In particular, commercial PV capacity rose by 4.243 kW per 1000 people per half-year following the blackout. Additional analysis suggests that the intermittent nature of solar power may limit the reliability of residential PV systems during emergencies, especially under adverse weather conditions. These findings highlight the need to address intermittency to enhance the role of PV systems as resilient infrastructure.
abstract_zh: 电力供应的意外冲击可能影响人们投资可再生能源的决策，尤其是当这些技术作为备用电源的替代品时。本研究探讨了大规模停电对后续光伏安装的影响，并考察了家庭和企业如何评估光伏系统作为应急电源的预期效益。采用双重稳健差分中的差分设计，我们利用2018年日本北海道胆振东部地震作为自然实验，估计了随后停电对市级光伏安装的影响。结果显示，停电显著增加了商业光伏安装，但对住宅安装无影响。具体而言，停电后每半年每千人商业光伏容量增加了4.243千瓦。进一步分析表明，太阳能发电的间歇性可能限制住宅光伏系统在紧急情况下的可靠性，尤其是在不利天气条件下。这些发现强调了解决间歇性问题以增强光伏系统作为韧性基础设施的作用的必要性。

title: Emission Taxes and the Nexus Between Technology Improvement and Technology Adoption
title_zh: 排放税与技术改进与技术采纳之间的关联
title_primary: 排放税与技术改进与技术采纳之间的关联
title_secondary: Emission Taxes and the Nexus Between Technology Improvement and Technology Adoption
authors: Jannis Kaesler, Till Requate
official: 官方在线 2026-04-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the impact of a policy mix, consisting of an emissions tax and an R&D subsidy on both abatement technology improvement (R&D) and technology adoption. In an upstream industry with market power (monopoly or duopoly) an improved abatement technology is developed for polluting downstream firms that are subject to the aforementioned policy mix. These firms can adopt the new technology, which has different value for each firm, leading to product differentiation. First, we study the optimal policy, which includes output subsidies. Next, we examine second-best policy mixes, such as emission taxes and R&D expenditure subsidies, for different market forms. We identify novel aspects of these policy mixes. For instance, in a monopoly, the optimal second-best policy must account for the intra-marginal benefits of adopting firms. In a duopoly, the policy mix must also address strategic under- or overinvestment by upstream technology developers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种政策组合的影响，该组合包括排放税和研发补贴，旨在促进减排技术的改进（研发）及其采纳。在一个具有市场力量（垄断或双头垄断）的上游行业中，为受上述政策组合约束的污染型下游企业开发了改进的减排技术。这些企业可以采纳新技术，而该技术对每家企业具有不同的价值，从而导致产品差异化。首先，我们研究了包含产出补贴的最优政策。接着，我们考察了不同市场形态下的次优政策组合，如排放税和研发支出补贴。我们识别出这些政策组合的新颖方面。例如，在垄断情况下，最优次优政策必须考虑采纳企业的边际内收益。在双头垄断情况下，政策组合还必须应对上游技术开发者的策略性投资不足或过度投资问题。
